purpose: A pending detached middle has a distinct owning copied return and a raw reference-row cache. SEND must snapshot the dereferenced row before ignored-argument destruction mutates its shared cell through COW; actual parent close and later snapshot cleanup distinguish the owners.

class ReviewOwningSendArgument28 { function __destruct() { echo "S|"; $GLOBALS["row"][0] = new ReviewOwningSendNew28(); echo "W|"; } }
function &reviewOwningSendChild28() { global $row; $row = [new ReviewOwningSendCache28()]; echo "C|"; yield $row; echo "L|"; $answer = new ReviewOwningSendReturn28(); return $answer; }
function reviewOwningSendMiddle28() { try { echo "M|"; $answer = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-TAIL|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }

$child = reviewOwningSendChild28(); $middle = reviewOwningSendMiddle28(); $outer = reviewOwningSendOuter28();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); echo "H|", $middle->current()[0] instanceof ReviewOwningSendCache28 ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($child); echo "D|";
$snapshot = $middle->send(new ReviewOwningSendArgument28()); echo "V|", $snapshot[0] instanceof ReviewOwningSendCache28 ? 1 : 0, "|LIVE|", $row[0] instanceof ReviewOwningSendNew28 ? 1 : 0, "|K|", $middle->key() === null ? 1 : 0, "|";

purpose: An inherited pending middle has a present-null current and an owning copied array containing a live embedded global reference. Ignored SEND returns null without consuming the child result; close and a subsequent actual shared-cell write distinguish retained array ownership from frozen referents.
